_how: TODD's monologue before the fight. Each line is typed out while his screen shows what's in 'show' (one after another, if there's more than one): a picture from 'pictures', or 'face:NAME' for one of his own faces (smile, neutral, happy, angry, surprised, sly, sad, error, loading). 'pose' is what his body does: lean, preach, slump, point, peer, rage, palm or look. 'shake' is a word that shakes the screen when it's typed. 'secs' is how long the line stays. After the last line he throws his arms in the air and the fight starts. Pictures with 'urls' load from Wikimedia while the page runs (never copied into the repo); 'drawn' ones are made from the site's own art.

lines.text: I was GOD once. GOD of VARANDIA.
Banished to this realm of despair and misery.
The Salesman and Wonder, here too.

_how2: 'title' is the card before the fight (click to start). 'death' is the card when you die: 'heading', and one of 'quotes' (TODD talking) picked at random. 'win' is the banner when you beat him. These are drafts: rewrite them.

quotes: Go back to your two dimensions.
